capabilities: search book catalogs by title, author, or ISBN
create templated book notes with metadata and cover
fill frontmatter properties of an existing note
log reading status, rating, progress, and quotes as note properties
create a Bases bookshelf view with a cover gallery
extras: Google Books and Open Library work without any key; Aladin results must show a required credit line. Requires Obsidian 1.9+ only for the Bases bookshelf view.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up book metadata from catalogs or turn a search result into a complete book note with cover, properties and reading log.

relations.evidence: Kakao Book Search — fast, complete search for books published in Korea.
Aladin — Korean bookstore data with page count, table of contents, original title, series, and categories.
Open Library — free international catalog with page counts and subjects; no key needed.

summary: Book note creator that searches Kakao, Aladin, Google Books and Open Library by title or ISBN to build templated book notes with a reading log and bookshelf view.
